title: On $m$-partite oriented semiregular representations of finite groups
summary: The study of ORR was inspired by Lázsló Babai in 1980 when he asked a question: Which [finite] groups admit an oriented graph as a DRR? And it has been solved by Joy Morris and Pablo Spiga through a series of papers in 2018. In this paper, we will extend the concept of ORR to $m$-partite oriented graphs for $m\geq 2$. We say that a finite group $G$ admits an \emph{$m$-partite oriented semiregular representation} ($m$-POSR) if there exists an $m$-partite oriented graph $\G$ such that its automorphism group is isomorphic to $G$ and acts semiregularly with the $m$ orbits giving the partition.…
